FFmpeg runtime redistribution is not enabled for this build.

The adjacent FFmpeg DLLs are present only for local KatanaRecomp development
and product bring-up. Do not publish, upload, redistribute, or describe this
directory as a release package.

A redistributable build must provide KATANA_FFMPEG_CORRESPONDING_SOURCE_ARCHIVE
and KATANA_FFMPEG_CORRESPONDING_SOURCE_SHA256 at configure time. The archive
must have been produced from the exact source inputs recorded in NOTICE.txt
and BUILD-CONFIGURATION.txt, including the complete pinned BtbN source cache.
KatanaRecomp then replaces this marker with FFmpeg-Corresponding-Source.zip.
